let idx = context.get('regIndex');
if (!idx) {
    idx = {};
    for (const [unit, table, addr, name, scale, offset, einheit, signed] of REG_MAP) {
        const tbl = table === 0 ? 'holding' : 'input';
        idx[unit + '|' + tbl + '|' + addr] = { name, scale, offset, einheit, signed };
    }
    context.set('regIndex', idx);
}

const [unitStr, table, startStr, countStr] = (msg.topic || '').split('|');
const unit = parseInt(unitStr, 10);
const start = parseInt(startStr, 10);
const tableName = table === 'holding' ? 'holding' : 'input';

const raw = (msg.payload && msg.payload.data) ? msg.payload.data : msg.payload; // Array roher 16-bit Registerwerte
if (!Array.isArray(raw)) {
    node.warn('Kein Register-Array erhalten: ' + JSON.stringify(msg.payload));
    return null;
}

const out = {};
for (let i = 0; i < raw.length; i++) {
    const addr = start + i;
    const key = unit + '|' + tableName + '|' + addr;
    const meta = idx[key];
    if (!meta) continue; // Register nicht in der Map (z.B. unser Testregister 22) - wird ignoriert
    let val = raw[i];
    if (meta.signed && val > 32767) val = val - 65536;
    const scale = meta.scale || 1;
    const offset = meta.offset || 0;
    const value = (val - offset) / scale;
    out[`u${unit}_${tableName}_${addr}`] = {
        name: meta.name,
        value: Math.round(value * 1000) / 1000,
        einheit: meta.einheit
    };
}

msg.payload = out;
return msg;
